Expected result: An index is created if existing data meets uniqueness; duplicate SKU writes fail.

Interview question: Does an index always speed up every query?
Answer: No. Its benefit depends on query shape and selectivity; writes also become more
expensive.

Remember: Faster reads, extra write cost.
